manifest_row.title: Russia Orders Review Of Infrastructure On Melting Permafrost In Wake of Arctic Fuel Spill

screening.main_topic: A major fuel spill in Norilsk linked to thawing permafrost and the resulting review of hazardous infrastructure built on permafrost.
screening.climate_relevance: The report connects the spill to permafrost thaw, identifies climate change as a threat to Arctic infrastructure, and cites anomalously warm Siberian temperatures.
screening.reason: Although the immediate focus is the fuel spill and its cleanup, climate-related permafrost thaw is a substantial part of the explanation and broader significance of the disaster.
